question: A shopkeeper sells an article for Rs. 360 after allowing a discount of 10%. What would have been its selling price (in Rs.) had he offered a discount of 20%?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price after 10% discount = ₹360

**Formula used:**

Original Price (P) = Selling Price / (1 - Discount Rate)

New Selling Price = Original Price × (1 - New Discount Rate)

**Calculation:**

Let the original price be P.

⇒ P = 360 / (1 - 0.10)

⇒ P = 360 / 0.90

⇒ P = 400
